claims: TPSM incorporates multi-quasiparticle states up to 6-qp for even-even nuclei, solving the 3D projected Hill-Wheeler equation with the Pfaffian algorithm.
The K-plot and azimuthal plot P(theta, phi) strictly quantify the spatial orientation probability density of total angular momentum on the ellipsoid.

In 136Nd, TPSM confirms a dynamic phase transition from low-spin chiral vibration (single coplanar peak in D1, twin peaks in D1-C, Ki=0 node) to high-spin static chirality (symmetric aplanar double peaks in both bands with Ki=15 hbar).
In even-even 130Ba, transverse wobbling on the pi h11/2^2 configuration yields comparable B(M1)out/B(E2)in and B(E2)out/B(E2)in because the 2-qp alignment enhances intrinsic M1 matrix elements.
Azimuthal plot P(theta, phi) for 130Ba shows a symmetric single peak along the short axis for n=0 and a node with twin peaks for n=1, confirming precession around the short axis.
